title: put-context-engine-ai-index-aiindexid
description: Create or update an AI Index

aiIndexId.description: The unique identifier of the AI Index.

automations.description: Automations associated with the AI Index. Defaults to an empty array when omitted.

description.description: Human-readable description of the AI Index.

type.description: The type of the backing store. `data_stream` for a data stream, or `index` for an index.

value.description: The data stream or index (e.g. `ai-index-ds-foo`, `ai-index-idx-foo`) the AI Index is attached to. Must name a single data stream or index (no wildcards or comma-separated lists), match `type`, and start with `ai-index-ds-` (for `data_stream`) or `ai-index-idx-` (for `index`). The rest of the value must be a valid AI Index ID. System indices are not allowed.

dest.description: The data stream or index that backs the AI Index.

agent_id.description: Agent Builder agent ID that runs this index’s feedback-loop analysis.

allowed_actions.description: Improvement actions the analysis may propose. An empty list is observe-only.

enabled.description: Desired state of the recurring analysis. The scheduler stays authoritative for whether it is actually running.

interval.description: How often to analyze, for example `1h` or `24h`. At least 15 minutes.

signal_filter.description: KQL narrowing which signals this index analyzes, for example `tags: query_error`.

from.description: Date math relative to now, for example `now-30d`.
ISO 8601 date to analyze signals since.

signal_time_range.description: Which signals the analysis reads. A read filter only.

feedback_analysis.description: The recurring feedback analysis, which reads agent signals and proposes improvement actions for the AI Index.

value.description: The source value; an ES|QL query when `type` is `esql`. Must be valid ES|QL.
The source value; a connector ID when `type` is `connector`.

sources.description: Additional sources that provide context for the AI Index. Defaults to an empty array when omitted.

value.description: An index or data stream name or pattern to read traces from.
An ES|QL query to select traces.

traces.description: Trace sources linked to this AI Index. A write replaces the whole array. Defaults to an empty array when omitted.
